description: Change the DDoS filtering on one IP of a dedicated server. Read the current state first with `impreza_api_call` on /dedicated/{serviceId}/firewall, and the recent attacks with /dedicated/{serviceId}/firewall/logs. Higher sensitivity filters more, and also drops more legitimate traffic — turning it up during an attack is right, leaving it up afterwards is usually not. Both state and sensitivity are optional: whatever you omit is left as it is.

ip.description: Which IP of the server to change.

sensitivity.description: How aggressively to filter. Omit to leave unchanged.

state.description: Filtering on or off. Omit to leave unchanged.

name: impreza_dedicated_firewall
